description: Land Acquisition - Veddukkadu, Poonakary D/S Division, Paramankirai G.N Division Kilinochchi District (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land plots, their locations, extents, and the legal process for acquisition and compensation. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it focuses on land and property-related matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
